sources.title: RehearseVLA: Simulated Post-Training for VLAs with Physically ...
sources.snippet: RehearseVLA consists of two key components: (1) a physically-consistent world simulator that generates temporally consistent future visual observations, and (2) a vision-language model (VLM)-guided instant reflector that provides continuous reward signals and predicts action termination.
